body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its network Blu-ray home theater system 'LHB979' at LG press conference during 2009 CES.

It features set and delivering a pure HD audio and video experience, and powerful 1000W of performance with a champagne speaker silhouette and two wireless rear satellite speakers designed by renowned audio expert Mr. Mark Levinson. It is expected to be available in 2Q of 2009.
